'''Greg Miller''' is a Star Wars CCG player whose decks were published on [[Trandosite]], [[Rod Latham]]'s UK fan site.<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls131.htm Our Most Desparate Hour], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041027103638/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls131.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
